findings.claim_or_location: [11] bibliography entry + line 31 / Key Claim 3: 'between-day reliability of lnRMSSD ... ICCs reported from 0.37 to 0.93 with between-day CV from ~3.5% to 36.5% [11, cohort]'
findings.issue: Wrong attribution. [11] is cited as 'Bellenger CR, et al. ... 2024. Scientific Reports. DOI: 10.1038/s41598-024-58217-1. PMC11055755'. Verified: PMC11055755 is actually Fennell CRJ et al., 'Inter-day reliability of heart rate complexity and variability metrics in healthy highly active younger and older adults', European Journal of Applied Physiology, 2023 — not Bellenger, not Scientific Reports, not 2024. The cited DOI (10.1038/...58217-1) is a Scientific Reports article distinct from PMC11055755, so the identifier bundle is internally inconsistent. The claimed numbers (ICC 0.37-0.93, CV ~3.5-36.5%) do NOT match what PMC11055755 reports (lnRMSSD ICC 0.57-0.79, between-day CV 4.42-5.09%). The load-bearing reliability range grounding 'CV can exceed 30%' is not traceable to the cited source.
findings.recommended_fix: Identify the actual source of the ICC 0.37-0.93 / CV 3.5-36.5% range and cite it correctly with matching author/year/journal/PMID/DOI, OR replace with PMC11055755 (Fennell 2023, EJAP) and restate the numbers to that paper's actual values (ICC 0.57-0.79, CV 4.42-5.09%) — but note those do not support 'CV can exceed 30%', so Key Claim 3 must be re-grounded or softened.

findings.claim_or_location: Line 53 / Key Claim 9: 'VO2max SMD 0.13 (CI -0.12 to 0.39, p=0.30) [16, meta_analysis]'
findings.issue: Numeric mis-transcription of a published effect size. Verified against Manresa-Rocamora 2021 (PMID 34639599, IJERPH): the VO2max effect is SMD 0.20 (95% CI -0.07 to 0.47), not SMD 0.13 (CI -0.12 to 0.39). The endurance-performance figure the section gives (SMD 0.20, CI -0.09 to 0.48) is correct, and the vagal-HRV SMD 0.50 (CI 0.09-0.91) is correct, but the VO2max value is wrong. Conclusion (non-significant, modest) is unaffected, but the stated number/CI/p do not match the source.
findings.recommended_fix: Correct the VO2max figure to SMD 0.20 (95% CI -0.07 to 0.47) per the published meta-analysis, and confirm the associated p-value against the paper.

findings.recommended_fix: Change the citation year to 2021 to match the PubMed record (or note 'epub 2020, print 2021').
